purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Muvattupuzha

queries.query: Muvattupuzha official cadastral parcel map Kerala GIS land records
queries.result: First-party discovery found Kerala Bhu-Naksha, Ente Bhoomi, Kerala Revenue eMaps, the Muvattupuzha Municipality official map page, and KMAP. Bhu-Naksha is the strongest cadastral-map lead, but no anonymous Muvattupuzha parcel ID-plus-geometry response was qualified.

queries.query: മൂവാറ്റുപുഴ ഔദ്യോഗിക ഭൂപ്പടം ഭൂമിരേഖ കഡസ്ട്രൽ ജിഐഎസ്
queries.result: Malayalam first-party discovery found Kerala government land-record and digital-survey portals plus the official Muvattupuzha Municipality site. The observed workflows require village/block/survey inputs and/or CAPTCHA or login; no safe anonymous parcel-vector endpoint was verified.

registryEvidence.basis: Kerala state cadastral and land-record portals were identified, and the official Muvattupuzha Municipality portal was verified, but a Muvattupuzha-local cadastral registry/map procedure or city-specific open parcel feed was not established.
registryEvidence.localCustodianScope: Muvattupuzha Municipality is an official local-government portal and publishes a municipality map page, but the observed map is not evidence of cadastral parcel-vector coverage. Kerala Revenue/Survey portals are state custodial leads, not local registry evidence.

officialSources.observation: Official Kerala Bhu-Naksha page describes cadastral mapping and exposes block/survey/subdivision search controls; current host failed TLS verification from the workspace, so its live schema and geometry service were not inspected.

Official Kerala Revenue page describes eMaps as cadastral mapping integrated with textual land records and says updated digital sketches can be provided; this is general state-agency prose, not Muvattupuzha coverage evidence.

Official Ente Bhoomi survey search exposes district/taluk/village/block/survey-number/subdivision inputs and CAPTCHA; no anonymous parcel geometry was exposed in the retrieved HTML/JavaScript workflow.
Official Muvattupuzha Municipality page provides Map_Ernakulam_Muvattupuzha.pdf and a map link, but not a parcel-vector service in the observed page.
Current official KMAP viewer shell was retrieved; its JavaScript references a KMAP ArcGIS Plot_Licensee permit layer, not cadastral parcels.

source.name: Kerala Bhu-Naksha / Revenue eMaps / Ente Bhoomi and Muvattupuzha Municipality/KMAP leads

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Kerala state cadastral/digital land-record portals and official Muvattupuzha municipal mapping leads were identified.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response, native parcel identity, parcel schema, CRS, or citywide completeness was verified for Muvattupuzha.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point [9.99455430126789, 76.5792956470536] was preserved and not shifted. TLS failure, CAPTCHA-gated survey workflow, permit-layer response, and lack of an exact-point query do not establish citywide cadastral absence. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
